title: Spreading a finite etale Galois cover
statement:
Let $S$ be a
quasi-compact and
quasi-separated integral
normal scheme with generic point $\eta$. Let
$C\to S$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated
smooth morphism with
geometrically connected
fibres, and fix a section $\sigma:S\to C$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$
be a finite etale
Galois cover with group
$G$, assume $|G|$ is
invertible on $S$, and assume $Z$ has a $\kappa(\eta)$-rational point
mapping to $\sigma(\eta)$. Then there is a finite etale
Galois cover
$\widetilde Z\to C$ with group $G$ whose restriction to $C_\eta$ is the
given cover $Z\to C_\eta$.
(*Stacks Project, Fundamental Groups of Schemes, [Tag `0EZJ`](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EZJ) = Lemma 58.31.9.*)

proof.text: Choose the underlying finite etale surjective extension P -> C and its cartesian generic comparison ψ using lem-sbc-underlying-finite-etale-extension.
Apply lem-sbc-generic-fibre-action-extension to that finite etale extension to obtain the action over C, its unit and multiplication laws, equivariance of ψ, and the torsor isomorphism.

Form the GaloisCover structure from P, its structure morphism, finiteness, etaleness and surjectivity from step 1, and the action with its laws and torsor condition from step 2. Return this cover and ψ with the existing cartesian-square and equivariance proofs.

proof_origin.note: The unit route remains inside the underlying extension input. The explicit Lean assembly combines the finite etale cover and the action fields.
